{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: The River & The Thread; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots-oriented songwriting sounds appealing, but I would focus on familiar artists this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: No Fools, No Fun – 2 Track Bonus Version; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not recognize this release well enough to choose it during a quick visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: CSNY 1974; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The classic-rock connection interests me, but a substantial live release is more than I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having listened to Old Sock, I would choose this for Clapton's relaxed blues sound and the JJ Cale connection.
ItemID: NA; Title: Bad Self Portraits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The soulful roots sound could fit my interest in Memphis, but it is a less immediate choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: You Should Be So Lucky makes me interested in hearing more from Benmont Tench with Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers.
ItemID: NA; Title: High Hopes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Springsteen's rock songwriting fits my recent listening, but I would prioritize the two strongest connections today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Jackson Browne's songwriting appeals to me, though I am not looking to explore another album this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Stockholm; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Chrissie Hynde's familiar voice interests me, but this feels less compelling than the Clapton and Petty releases.
ItemID: NA; Title: Songs From St. Somewhere; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The laid-back tropical direction is less suited to the blues and roots rock I want right now."}
